select * from ( SELECT a.binding_id bindingId , a.mach_type machType, a.mach_sn machSn, a.mach_mac machMac, a.uuid, a.device_flag deviceFlag, DATE_FORMAT( a.binding_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) bindingTime, DATE_FORMAT( a.unbind_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) unbindTime, a.binding_status bindingStatus , a.company_id companyId, a.dept_id deptId, b.user_name userName, b.user_tel userTel, b.user_status userStatus, b.status, b.user_id userId FROM cust_user_mach a LEFT JOIN cust_userinfo b ON a.user_id=b.user_id where a.dept_id in (select distinct dept_id from comm_user_mng_dept where user_id=#{loginUserId}) )temp where 1=1
and ${key} like CONCAT('%',#{tm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
order by ${column} ${order}
order by bindingTime desc

select * from cust_user_mach where IFNULL(binding_status, 0) =1 AND user_id=#{userId}
AND mach_sn=#{machSn}
